build_MLPSpeculatorHead: build an MLP speculator head that combines an LM head with a speculator model for speculative decoding
create_MLPSpeculatorModel: create an MLP speculator model with separate embedding, projection, head, and layer norm modules per prediction step
create_MLPSpeculatorModelTied: create a tied-weight MLP speculator model that reuses the same embedding and projection layers across prediction steps
implement_MLPSpeculatorLayerNorm: implement a custom L2 layer normalization module with learned weight and bias parameters for MLP speculator layers
use_simple_norm: use the simple_norm function to apply L2 normalization scaled by inverse square root of 2 to a tensor
